# Anointed Automation

> Open-source .NET / NuGet libraries by Anointed Automation, LLC, stewarded by Alexander Fields. This repository (github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation) is a collection of small, focused, dependency-light C# packages published to NuGet under the AnointedAutomation.* prefix.

Jesus is King ✝️

Every package targets net10.0, is MIT licensed, and installs with `dotnet add package <PackageId>`. Machine-readable version: llms.json. Longer guide with code samples: llms.md.

Primary site: https://anointedautomation.net
NuGet profile: https://www.nuget.org/profiles/roku674

## Packages

- [AnointedAutomation.Algorithms](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Algorithms): Algorithms for .NET with no dependencies, starting with a pure C# QR code encoder (ISO/IEC 18004) with Reed-Solomon error correction and automatic version and mask selection. Version 1.0.3, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Algorithms.QrCode, QrEncoder, QrMatrix, QrErrorCorrectionLevel. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Algorithms
- [AnointedAutomation.APIMiddlewares](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.APIMiddlewares): ASP.NET Core middleware and filters for API key authentication, IP blacklisting, invalid endpoint tracking and idle time memory cleanup. Version 1.0.7, net10.0. NuGet deps: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App (framework reference). AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Logging, AnointedAutomation.Memory. Key: AnointedAutomation.APIMiddleware, AnointedAutomation.APIMiddleware.Filters, ApiKeyAuthMiddleware, IPBlacklistMiddleware, InvalidEndpointTrackerMiddleware, EndpointAccessMiddleware. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.APIMiddlewares
- [AnointedAutomation.Concepts](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Concepts): Models Biblical concepts as .NET types: love as a behavior tree, a moral reality that reads acts against God's character, and an epistemics engine that checks claims for consistency. Version 1.0.4, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Concepts, AnointedAutomation.Concepts.Epistemics, Love, LoveAction, Situation, MoralConcept. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Concepts
- [AnointedAutomation.Enums](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Enums): Shared enumerations for AnointedAutomation packages: payment types, providers, transaction and subscription statuses, payment operations, card types, webhook events, and moderation categories. Version 1.0.5, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Enums, PaymentProvider, PaymentType, TransactionStatus, SubscriptionStatus. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Enums
- [AnointedAutomation.Imaging](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Imaging): Renders QR codes from AnointedAutomation.Algorithms to SVG and PNG using only the .NET base class library, with no third party image dependency. Version 1.0.3, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Algorithms. Key: AnointedAutomation.Imaging.QrCode, QrRenderer. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Imaging
- [AnointedAutomation.Logging](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Logging): A lightweight log message model with severity levels, automatic caller detection and a static LogAdded event for routing logs. Version 1.0.4, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Optimization.Logging, LogMessage, MessageType, LogMessageEventArgs. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Logging
- [AnointedAutomation.Mathematics](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Mathematics): A curated catalog of laws, theories, and conjectures from logic, mathematics, physics, and chemistry, modeled as foundational claims for the AnointedAutomation.Concepts epistemics engine. Version 1.0.3, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Concepts. Key: AnointedAutomation.Mathematics, UniversalLaws, UniversalPropositions, PhysicalTheories, Conjectures. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Mathematics
- [AnointedAutomation.Memory](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Memory): On demand garbage collection helper that forces a full collection and tries to return unused memory to the operating system. Version 1.0.5, net10.0. NuGet deps: none. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Optimization.Memory, GarbageCollection. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Memory
- [AnointedAutomation.Objects](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Objects): Plain POCO models for user accounts, billing and payments, single sign-on identities (Google, Microsoft, Apple, Facebook, Shopify), and standard API response envelopes. Version 2.3.1, net10.0. NuGet deps: Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.4. AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Enums, AnointedAutomation.Shopify, AnointedAutomation.Serialization. Key: AnointedAutomation.Objects, AnointedAutomation.Objects.Account, User, UserEmail, UserEmailSource, Profile, SSO, ResponseData. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Objects
- [AnointedAutomation.Objects.API](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Objects.API): ASP.NET Core helpers: an in memory IFormFile, a hybrid casing System.Text.Json naming convention, and a GraphQL response envelope reader. Version 1.3.0, net10.0. NuGet deps: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App (framework reference). AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Objects, AnointedAutomation.Serialization. Key: AnointedAutomation.Objects.API, CustomFormFile, JsonCasingConvention, UtcDateTimeJsonConverter, GraphQlEnvelope. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Objects.API
- [AnointedAutomation.Optimization](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Optimization): Reusable optimization utilities: CSV/DataTable/DataReader helpers, chunking, string helpers, Roman numerals, JSON flattening, file management, and null-safe JsonElement/BsonDocument field accessors. Version 1.0.1, net10.0. NuGet deps: MongoDB.Bson 3.12.0. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Optimization, Utility, Roman, JsonFlattener, JsonElementExtensions. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Optimization
- [AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo): A MongoDB helper and generic repository base for .NET, with CRUD, paging, aggregation, index management, BSON class maps and casing conventions. Version 1.3.0, net10.0. NuGet deps: MongoDB.Bson 3.12.0, MongoDB.Driver 3.12.0, MongoDB.Libmongocrypt 1.12.0, Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.4. AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Logging, AnointedAutomation.Objects, AnointedAutomation.Serialization. Key: AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo, AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo.Bson, MongoHelper, IMongoHelper, MongoRepository<TDoc>, MongoDocument. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Repository.Mongo
- [AnointedAutomation.Repository.MySql](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Repository.MySql): A generic repository and helper for MySQL over Entity Framework Core and the Pomelo provider. Version 1.0.5, net10.0. NuGet deps: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 10.0.12, Pomelo.EntityFrameworkCore.MySql 9.0.0. AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Logging. Key: AnointedAutomation.Repository.MySql, GenericRepository<T>, IGenericRepository<T>, MySqlHelper, IMySqlHelper. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Repository.MySql
- [AnointedAutomation.Serialization](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Serialization): Shared serialization helpers: naming rules (camel, Pascal, snake and the hybrid value/reference casing rule), System.Text.Json casing convention, presets and UTC DateTime converter, tolerant Newtonsoft.Json converters, and lenient JsonElement readers. No MongoDB dependency. Version 1.0.0, net10.0. NuGet deps: Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.4. AnointedAutomation deps: none. Key: AnointedAutomation.Serialization.Naming, AnointedAutomation.Serialization.SystemTextJson, AnointedJson, JsonPresets, JsonCasingConvention, NamingRules. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Serialization
- [AnointedAutomation.Shopify](https://www.nuget.org/packages/AnointedAutomation.Shopify): Plain Newtonsoft.Json POCO models for the Shopify Admin REST API (customers, orders, products, fulfillments, inventory, refunds, transactions, webhooks and more), derived from ShopifySharp's REST entities. Models only: no HTTP client, no services, no GraphQL types. Version 1.0.0, net10.0. NuGet deps: Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.4. AnointedAutomation deps: AnointedAutomation.Serialization. Key: AnointedAutomation.Shopify, AnointedAutomation.Shopify.Converters, Customer, Order, Product, Fulfillment. Source: https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/tree/master/AnointedAutomation.Shopify

## Docs

- [llms.md](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/llms.md): expanded guide with a quick-start snippet per package and cross-package recipes
- [llms.json](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/llms.json): the same package data as structured JSON
- [README](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/README.md): overview, install, dependency graph
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): file header standard and conventions

## Project facts

- [License](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/LICENSE): MIT. AnointedAutomation.Shopify (and portions of AnointedAutomation.Serialization) are derived from ShopifySharp, MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Joshua Harms.
- [File header](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): every source file starts with the copyright line, ending in "Jesus is King ✝️", e.g. `// Copyright © Anointed Automation, LLC., 2026. All Rights Reserved. Stewarded by Alexander Fields https://www.alexanderfields.me Jesus is King ✝️`
- [Publishing](https://github.com/AnointedAutomation/AnointedAutomation/blob/master/PUBLISHING.md): Work lands on develop. A develop to master pull request auto increments changed package versions; merging to master publishes each package whose version is newer than NuGet.org.
